response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced senior/staff engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded and platform work, plus a CS degree — technically far beyond what this entry-level role requires. However, the position is explicitly junior, and the two hard requirements it hinges on are a poor match: German is listed as only 'Basic' against a requirement for strong verbal and written German (essential for client-facing insurance consulting in Germany), and Java appears only as a legacy skill from 2016–2018 with no recent object-oriented Java depth (his recent stack is TypeScript/Node/DLang). There is also significant overqualification and compensation/retention risk in placing a Staff Engineer into an entry-level IC role. Strong candidate overall, wrong role.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience with strong software craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, pairing)
Completed BS in Computer Science plus demonstrated agile and consulting-project background
Proven communicator — workshops, conference talks, and teaching OOP/testing courses
concerns: German listed as 'Basic' against a strong German requirement for client work
Severely overqualified for an entry-level role — retention and salary mismatch
Java is peripheral and dated; recent work is TypeScript/Node/DLang, not JVM
